subject: Geopolitics
title: Cyber Warfare and Information
description: A short lesson to help you apply Cyber Warfare and Information.

hook.text: Before invading Ukraine, Russia launched cyberattacks on government websites and spread fake evacuation orders.

buildup.text: Cyber warfare targets communication networks, power grids, and media.

discovery.text: Combined with disinformation, cyberattacks create confusion. Populations can't verify what's real when systems are down.

twist.text: Smaller nations and non-state actors use cyber tools too. The barrier to entry is low: a laptop and skill, not an army.

climax.text: Information warfare now starts before bullets. The first strikes in modern war target networks, not borders.

punchline.text: The first shot in modern war hits a server, not a wall.

quiz.question: Why do cyberattacks precede physical military action?
options: International law requires digital warnings before war
They disrupt communication and create confusion before invasion
Cyberattacks are a substitute for all kinetic warfare
